title: President Trump claims injecting people with disinfectant could treat coronavirus
summary: A Telegraph news clip of the April 2020 White House briefing in which President Trump wondered aloud about disinfectants and sunlight as coronavirus treatments, prompting a backlash from medical experts.
why: HN mostly uses it as a source for what Trump actually said, and commenters argue over whether it was sarcasm or whether the headline was accurate.
